parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.
> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the cluster.
> You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb describe-kernel-version --db-cluster-id am-bp1ub9grke10000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
